nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned storing reflection balances
mapping(address=>uint256) _tOwned storing plain token balances of excluded accounts
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances ERC20 allowance table
bool public canTrade trading enable flag
address public marketingWallet receiving ETH share from swaps and claims
uint256 public _maxTxAmount transfer amount cap
uint256 public numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity swap trigger threshold
bool inSwapAndLiquify guard used by lockTheSwap modifier
bool public swapAndLiquifyEnabled swap feature switch
uint256 public _taxFee reflection tax percentage
uint256 public _liquidityFee liquidity fee percentage
uint256 _rTotal total reflections minted at construction
uint256 _tFeeTotal accumulated fees
uint256 _tTotal fixed token supply
IUniswapV2Router02 immutable router reference
address immutable uniswapV2Pair LP pair for this token
address private _owner Ownable owner slot
uint256 private _lockTime owner lock timestamp
address private _previousOwner stashed during lock
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFee fee exemption table
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcluded reflection exclusion table
constructor: mints reflection supply, creates uniswap pair, sets fee exemptions
private _transfer: validates addresses/amounts/limits and drives swap and fee logic
private swapAndLiquify under lockTheSwap: splits balance, pays marketing, adds liquidity
private swapTokensForEth: approves router and swaps tokens for ETH
private addLiquidity: approves router and adds ETH liquidity to uniswap
private _tokenTransfer: applies canTrade gate, fee toggle and dispatch to variants
private _transferStandard: both parties non-excluded reflection transfer
private _transferToExcluded: recipient is excluded from reward
private _transferFromExcluded: sender is excluded from reward
private _transferBothExcluded: both parties excluded from reward
private _getValues: computes r/t transfer amounts, fees and liquidity
private _getRate: rSupply/tSupply rate used for conversions
private _getCurrentSupply: subtracts excluded balances from totals
private _takeLiquidity: credits reflection liquidity to the contract
private _reflectFee: burns rFee from _rTotal and accrues tFee
public transfer: ERC20 entrypoint calling _transfer
public transferFrom: spends allowance and calls _transfer
onlyOwner claimTokens: sends full ETH balance to marketingWallet
onlyOwner claimOtherTokens: transfers arbitrary ERC20 balance out
onlyOwner clearStuckBalance: sends ETH to caller-supplied payable address
onlyOwner setMarketingWallet: rewrites marketingWallet
onlyOwner setSwapThresholdAmount: rewrites swap trigger threshold
onlyOwner allowtrading: flips canTrade to true
onlyOwner excludeFromReward: adds account to _excluded set
onlyOwner includeInReward: removes account from _excluded set
onlyOwner lock: zeroes owner and sets timestamp based lock time
unlock: restores previous owner after timelock expires
deliver: burns reflection amount from caller and reduces _rTotal
private _approve: writes allowance table and emits Approval
private calculateTaxFee: amount * _taxFee / 100
private calculateLiquidityFee: amount * _liquidityFee / 100
public balanceOf: resolves excluded token balances or converts reflections
msg.sender untrusted caller identity used across transfer, allowance and ownership paths
block.timestamp untrusted time used for lock/unlock and router deadlines
payable(marketingWallet).transfer(...) external ETH send in swapAndLiquify/claimTokens
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens external swap call
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount} external value-bearing call
tokenAddress.transfer(...) call on an arbitrary ERC20 contract
walletaddress.transfer(address(this).balance) send to arbitrary payable address
address(this).balance.sub(initialBalance) arithmetic on contract ETH balance
tAmount token amount parameter of _getValues/_transferStandard/_transferToExcluded/_transferFromExcluded/_transferBothExcluded
account parameter of excludeFromReward/includeInReward
contractTokenBalance local computed from balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer
takeFee local flag deciding whether fees are applied in _tokenTransfer
marketingshare local share of swapped ETH sent to marketingWallet
SwapThresholdAmount parameter of setSwapThresholdAmount
time parameter of lock used to compute _lockTime

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer sender in the public transfer entrypoint
msg.sender is used as spender to reduce and rewrite its own allowance in transferFrom
_transfer receives from = _msgSender(), so caller identity selects the debited account
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender before restoring ownership
claimTokens is onlyOwner, so msg.sender must equal _owner to move ETH
lock computes _lockTime = block.timestamp + time, giving a timestamp driven ownership lock
unlock relies on block.timestamp > _lockTime to permit ownership restoration
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline
_reflectFee performs _rTotal = _rTotal.sub(rFee)
_reflectFee performs _tFeeTotal = _tFeeTotal.add(tFee)
_takeLiquidity adds rLiquidity to _rOwned[address(this)]
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount and adds rTransferAmount to _rOwned entries
_transferFromExcluded subtracts rAmount from _rOwned[sender] and adds to recipient
_transferFromExcluded performs _tOwned[sender].sub(tAmount)
_transferToExcluded performs _tOwned[recipient].add(tTransferAmount)
_transferBothExcluded updates _rOwned for both sender and recipient
_transferBothExcluded updates _tOwned for both sender and recipient
calculateTaxFee multiplies amount by _taxFee then divides by 10**2
calculateLiquidityFee multiplies amount by _liquidityFee then divides by 10**2
_getRate divides rSupply taken from _rTotal by tSupply
_getRate derives tSupply from _tTotal, so a zero tSupply would break division
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded _rOwned amounts from _rTotal
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded _tOwned amounts from _tTotal
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rOwned[sender]
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rTotal
deliver adds tAmount to _tFeeTotal
newBalance is computed by subtracting initialBalance from the contract ETH balance
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify when the contract token balance exceeds the threshold
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard when neither party is excluded
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded when recipient is excluded
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded when sender is excluded
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded when both are excluded
_getValues obtains the current rate via _getRate
_getValues reaches calculateTaxFee through _getTValues
_getValues reaches calculateLiquidityFee through _getTValues
_transferStandard calls _getValues to derive amounts
_transferStandard calls _takeLiquidity with the liquidity part
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with rFee and tFee
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth on half of the balance
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the other half and remaining ETH
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping
addLiquidity approves the router through _approve before adding liquidity
swapTokensForEth invokes the state-stored uniswapV2Router
addLiquidity invokes the state-stored uniswapV2Router
_takeLiquidity calls _getRate to convert token liquidity to reflections
if canTrade is false _tokenTransfer requires sender == owner(), restricting early transfers
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner participants
_transfer compares contract balance against numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates whether the automatic swap executes
_isExcludedFromFee determines the takeFee flag inside _transfer
inSwapAndLiquify is checked before swapping and set by the lockTheSwap modifier
public transfer forwards to _transfer
transferFrom forwards to _transfer before adjusting allowance
transferFrom subtracts the amount from _allowances via SafeMath.sub
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount
onlyOwner excludeFromReward sets _isExcluded[account] = true and pushes to _excluded
onlyOwner includeInReward clears _isExcluded[account] and pops the excluded entry
onlyOwner setMarketingWallet rewrites the ETH receiver address
onlyOwner setSwapThresholdAmount rewrites numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity
onlyOwner allowtrading sets canTrade = true, opening trading
claimTokens sends the whole contract balance to the owner-controlled marketingWallet
constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair for this token
constructor assigns the immutable uniswapV2Router
constructor assigns the entire _rTotal to _rOwned[msg.sender]
constructor exempts owner() and the contract from fees in _isExcludedFromFee
Ownable constructor sets _owner to the deployer, anchoring all onlyOwner rights
lock zeroes _owner, disabling owner-only functions until unlock
lock writes _lockTime from block.timestamp plus the supplied duration
lock stashes the outgoing owner into _previousOwner
unlock restores _owner = _previousOwner after the timelock
swapAndLiquify sends ETH to marketingWallet, an external address that can execute code on receipt
claimTokens pushes the full contract balance to marketingWallet via a state-inconsistent external call
claimOtherTokens calls transfer on an owner-supplied ERC20 that may be malicious
clearStuckBalance transfers contract ETH to an arbitrary caller-supplied payable address
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call while token state is mid-update
addLiquidity makes an external value-bearing router call that can trigger callbacks
the ETH send to marketingWallet can re-enter swapAndLiquify, which is only partially protected by inSwapAndLiquify
balanceOf converts _rOwned[account] through tokenFromReflection for non-excluded accounts
balanceOf returns _tOwned[account] directly for excluded accounts

normalization_plan.reason: tAmount is a numeric value parameter fully consumed by _getValues and the transfer variants, so it carries no independent semantic identity.
account is only used to key _isExcluded and _excluded writes inside the owner-only exclusion functions.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary derived from balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer before calling swapAndLiquify.
takeFee is a private flag computed in _transfer and consumed by _tokenTransfer to toggle fee removal.
marketingshare is a transient 75 percent share of swapped ETH sent straight to marketingWallet.
SwapThresholdAmount is only used to overwrite numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity in the owner-only setter.
time only feeds the block.timestamp based _lockTime assignment inside lock.
